metadata.question: Does the vegetation cover in Robinson Crusoe Island show higher greenness compared to Santa Clara Island in November 2018?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Compare mean NDVI over Robinson Crusoe Island and Santa Clara Island using Sentinel‑2 L2A (COPERNICUS/S2_SR) for 2018-11-01 to 2018-12-01 within buffered point geometries around each island. If no images, fall back to Sentinel‑2 L1C, then Landsat 8 L2.
2. Masking strategy: For Sentinel‑2 L2A, use SCL to keep only Vegetation (4) and Bare Soil (5), excluding clouds/shadows/water. For Sentinel‑2 L1C, mask QA60 cloud/cirrus. For Landsat 8 L2, mask QA_PIXEL clouds/shadows/cirrus/snow. Compute NDVI and median composite.
3. Logic: Check collection size (C1 if 0 after fallbacks). Compute valid pixel counts (C2 if 0). Validate NDVI range [-1, 1] and non-null (C3 if invalid). Then compare mean NDVI: A if Robinson Crusoe > Santa Clara, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const rcPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-78.83, -33.63]); // Robinson Crusoe Island
    const scPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-78.85, -33.69]); // Santa Clara Island
    const rcGeom = rcPoint.buffer({distance: 7000});     // ~7 km buffer around RC
    const scGeom = scPoint.buffer({distance: 2000});     // ~2 km buffer around SC
    const unionGeom = rcGeom.union(scGeom);
    const start = '2018-11-01';
    const end = '2018-12-01';
    const scale = 1000;

    // 2. Helper functions
    function s2SrNdvi(img) {
      const scl = img.select('SCL');
      const landMask = scl.eq(4).or(scl.eq(5)); // Vegetation or Bare Soil
      const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI');
      return ndvi.updateMask(landMask);
    }
    function s2L1cNdvi(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).neq(0).or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).neq(0));
      const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI');
      return ndvi.updateMask(cloud.not());
    }
    function l8l2Ndvi(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))     // cloud shadow
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))     // cirrus
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));    // snow
      const red = img.select('SR_B4').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      const nir = img.select('SR_B5').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      const ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('NDVI');
      return ndvi.updateMask(mask);
    }
    async function meanCloudiness(col) {
      let v = await col.aggregate_mean('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').getInfo();
      if (v !== null) return v;
      v = await col.aggregate_mean('CLOUD_COVER').getInfo();
      return v;
    }

    // 3. Data Acquisition & Fallbacks
    let dataset = null;
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(unionGeom);
    let n = await col.size().getInfo();
    if (n > 0) {
      dataset = {name: 'S2_L2A', col: col, mapFn: s2SrNdvi};
    } else {
      col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(unionGeom);
      n = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (n > 0) {
        dataset = {name: 'S2_L1C', col: col, mapFn: s2L1cNdvi};
      } else {
        col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .filterBounds(unionGeom);
        n = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (n > 0) {
          dataset = {name: 'L8_L2', col: col, mapFn: l8l2Ndvi};
        }
      }
    }
    if (!dataset) {
      console.log('Nov 2018 Images: 0');
      console.log('No data found for both islands in this period.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    const cloudMean = await meanCloudiness(dataset.col);
    console.log(`${dataset.name} Nov 2018 Images: ${n}` + (cloudMean != null ? ` (mean cloud %: ${cloudMean.toFixed(1)})` : ''));

    // 4. Processing
    const ndviMedian = dataset.col.map(dataset.mapFn).median().clip(unionGeom);

    // Valid pixel counts
    const rcCount = await ndviMedian.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: rcGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('NDVI').getInfo();
    const scCount = await ndviMedian.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: scGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('NDVI').getInfo();

    if (!rcCount || !scCount || rcCount === 0 || scCount === 0) {
      console.log(`RC pixels: ${rcCount || 0}, SC pixels: ${scCount || 0}`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking in one or both regions.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Calculation
    const rcMean = await ndviMedian.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: rcGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('NDVI').getInfo();
    const scMean = await ndviMedian.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: scGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('NDVI').getInfo();

    // 6. Validation & Final Answer
    const invalid = (v) => (v === null || !isFinite(v) || v < -1.2 || v > 1.2);
    if (invalid(rcMean) || invalid(scMean)) {
      console.log(`RC mean NDVI: ${rcMean}, SC mean NDVI: ${scMean}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`RC NDVI mean: ${rcMean.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${rcCount}`);
    console.log(`SC NDVI mean: ${scMean.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${scCount}`);

    if (rcMean > scMean) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err.message || err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
